title: ivx
text: R/ivx.R — ivx() / ivx_fit() (Kostakis, Magdalinos & Stamatogiannis 2015); core src/ivx_fit_cpp.cpp. Tuning via beta, cz, bandwidth; robust = TRUE Eicker-White; lag_y = TRUE lag-augmented (Demetrescu 2014). R/ivx-ar.R — ivx_ar() IVX-AR (Yang, Long, Peng & Cai 2020). R/ivx-ra.R — ivx_ra() residual-augmented IVX (Demetrescu & Rodrigues 2022); horizon > 1 transformed-regression test (Demetrescu, Rodrigues & Taylor 2023). R/ivx-qr.R — ivx_qr() IVX quantile regression (Lee 2016), ivx_qr_boot() block bootstrap (Fan & Lee 2019); uses quantreg. R/ivx-sys.R — ivx_sys() systems IVX (Magdalinos 2022); src/ivx_sys_fit_cpp.cpp. R/ivx-boot.R — ivx_boot() residual / fixed-regressor wild bootstrap (DGRT 2023); src/var_sim.cpp regressor recursion. R/ivx-episodic.R — ivx_episodic() subsample sup/ave tests (DGRT 2022); src/sub_ivx.cpp. R/ivx-iv.R — ivx_iv() 2SLS sine/fractional/long-difference instruments (Breitung & Demetrescu 2015). Non-IVX benchmarks: R/arm.R (arm(), Amihud-Hurvich-Wang 2009), R/hlt-test.R (hlt_test(), Harvey-Leybourne-Taylor 2021), R/el-test.R (el_test(), Liu-Yang-Cai-Peng 2019; el_ratio() generic Owen EL solver). R/ac_test.R — serial-correlation diagnostics. R/methods*.R, R/extract-texreg-methods.R — S3 / texreg support. R/auto-ar.R — AR order selection helper. tests/testthat/test-<file>.R mirrors R/ file. research/ — literature extensions (built). See research/CLAUDE.md.

text: predictive regression \[ y_t = \mu + \beta' x_{t-1} + u_t, \qquad x_t = \mu_x + R_n x_{t-1} + v_t, \qquad t = 1, \dots, n, \] relates stationary variable (return) lagged predictors often highly persistent, \(R_n = + C / n^{\alpha}\) \(\alpha \(0, 1]\), whose innovations \(v_t\) correlated \(u_t\). setting OLS t-statistic asymptotically normal: distribution depends unknown local--unity parameter \(C\) endogeneity correlation \(\delta = \mathrm{corr}(u_t, v_t)\), -rejects. package reports \(\delta\) delta().

title: IVX predictive regressions
text: KMS instrument \(x_{t-1}\) self-generated variable controlled, mildly integrated persistence, \[ z_t = \sum_{j=0}^{t-1} \rho_n^{\,j} \Delta x_{t-j}, \qquad \rho_n = 1 - \frac{c_z}{n^{\beta}}, \quad \beta \(0, 1), \; c_z > 0, \] .e. \(z_t = \rho_n z_{t-1} + \Delta x_t\) \(z_0 = 0\). Whatever persistence \(x_t\), \(z_t\) mildly integrated, IV estimator \[ \hat\beta_{ivx} = \Big( \sum_t z_{t-1} \tilde x_{t-1}' \Big)^{-1} \sum_t z_{t-1} \tilde y_t, \qquad \tilde x_{t-1} = x_{t-1} - \bar x, \; \tilde y_t = y_t - \bar y, \] asymptotically mixed normal. Wald statistic \(H_0: H\beta = h\), \[ W = (H\hat\beta_{ivx} - h)' \big[ H \hat Q H' \big]^{-1} (H\hat\beta_{ivx} - h) \;\\; \chi^2_{\mathrm{rank}(H)}, \] uses covariance \(\hat Q = (Z'\tilde X)^{-1} M (\tilde X' Z)^{-1}\) , KMS’s finite-sample corrected form, \[ M = \hat\sigma_u^2 \sum_t z_{t-1} z_{t-1}' \;-\; n \, \bar z \bar z' \, \hat\Sigma_{FM}, \qquad \hat\Sigma_{FM} = \hat\sigma_u^2 - \hat\Omega_{uv}' \hat\Omega_{vv}^{-1} \hat\Omega_{uv}, \] \(\hat\Omega\) Newey–West long-run (co)variances OLS residuals \(\hat u_t\) AR(1) residuals predictor, Bartlett bandwidth \(\lfloor n^{1/3} \rfloor\). subtracted term corrects finite-sample effect estimating intercept (KMS, p. 1516) package reports; summary() prints individual Wald statistics (equal squared t-ratios) joint statistic.

what: Bonferroni Q-Test of Campbell and Yogo (2006) — cy_test
title: Bonferroni Q-Test of Campbell and Yogo (2006) — cy_test
text: cy_test implements Bonferroni Q-test Campbell Yogo (2006), standard feasible version sup-bound / Bonferroni approach Cavanagh, Elliott Stock (1995). single predictor \(x_t = \gamma + \rho x_{t-1} + v_t\) (AR(p) dynamics allowed, Appendix ), procedure : estimate innovation correlation \(\delta\) predictive-regression residual ADF innovation predictor (lag length BIC, \(p \[1, p_{max}]\)); compute DF-GLS statistic Elliott, Rothenberg Stock (1996) invert local--unity null distribution (Stock, 1991) confidence interval \([\underline c, \bar c]\) \(c = T(\rho - 1)\), lower upper levels \(\underline\alpha_1(\delta)\), \(\bar\alpha_1(\delta)\) paper's Table 2, refine Bonferroni bound one-sided test size 5\ \(\rho\) end interval compute Q-estimate \(\hat\beta(\rho)\) eq. (25) - OLS \(y_t\) demeaned \(x_{t-1}\) subtracting \((\sigma_{ue}/\sigma_e\omega)(x_t - \rho x_{t-1})\), Phillips-Perron-type correction \(\tfrac{T}{2}(\sigma_{ue}/\sigma_e\omega)(\omega^2 - \sigma_v^2)\) \(p > 1\) - standard error \(\sigma_u (1-\delta^2)^{1/2}/(\sum x^{\mu 2}_{t-1})^{1/2}\); 90\ \([\hat\beta(\bar\rho) - 1.645\,se,\; \hat\beta(\underline\rho) + 1.645\,se]\) (eq. 17); 5\ bound positive \(\beta \ge 0\) upper bound negative. DF-GLS null quantiles tabulated simulation \(c \[-100, 10]\) (see data-raw/dfgls-quantiles.R); statistic outside tabulated range clamped boundary, negative values (clearly stationary predictor) makes interval \(c\) start \(-100\). Table 2 given \(\delta < 0\); \(\hat\delta > 0\) predictor sign-flipped, flips \(\beta\) alternative, results mapped back.

title: Fitting Residual-Augmented IVX Models — ivx_ra

title: Fitting Residual-Augmented IVX Models — ivx_ra
text: horizon > 1 estimator transformed-regression residual-augmented IVX Demetrescu, Rodrigues Taylor (2023), eqs (4.9), (4.11) (5.5)-(5.7): single-period response regressed \(h\)-period transformed instrument \(z_t^{trf,(h)} = \sum_{=\max(1,t-h+1)}^{\min(t,T-h)} z_i\) (eq. 4.4), accounts overlap long-horizon regression without HAC estimation. horizon = 1 coincides short-horizon estimator. coefficients estimate \(h\)-period slope \(eta_h\); fitted values residuals transformed (non-overlapping) regression, Kostakis et al. (2015) intercept correction applied horizon = 1. autoregression predictors fitted without intercept residuals demeaned augmentation, paper's preferred \(\tilde t_{ivx}^{\mu_0}\) statistic (Sections 4-5); standard errors include finite-sample correction Kostakis et al. (2015) paper's simulations.

title: ivx 1.2.0
text: New vignette “Rolling IVX tests bubble detection” showing build rolling-window IVX test Pavlidis, Paya & Peel (2017) ivx() (#2). ivx() ivx_fit() gain beta, cz bandwidth arguments expose IVX instrument tuning (previously hard-coded Kostakis et al. (2015) values) Newey-West bandwidth. ivx() gains robust = TRUE Eicker-White (heteroskedasticity-robust) IVX standard errors (Demetrescu, Georgiev, Rodrigues & Taylor, 2023). ivx() ivx_fit() gain lag_y = TRUE: lag-augmented IVX regression Demetrescu (2014), adds lagged dependent variable (instrumented ) raise local power strong persistence endogeneity. joint Wald statistic tests predictors . summary() coefficient tables now report Std. Error t value next individual Wald statistics; fitted object stores se tstat. Breaking: table gains two columns, code indexing coef(summary(x)) position must use column names ("Wald Ind", "Pr(> chi)") instead. New ivx_boot() implementing residual wild bootstrap fixed regressor wild bootstrap Demetrescu et al. (2023), returning bootstrap p-values joint individual Wald statistics one-sided t-tests. Supports cores > 1 via  package; regressor recursion residual wild bootstrap runs C++. New ivx_ra() / ivx_ra_fit(): residual-augmented (bias-reduced) IVX estimator Demetrescu & Rodrigues (2022) heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors; returns ivx object summary(), vcov() etc. apply. ivx_ra() gains horizon: horizon > 1 transformed-regression long-horizon test Demetrescu, Rodrigues & Taylor (2023), handles overlap long-horizon regression without HAC estimation. New ivx_qr() / ivx_qr_fit(): IVX-QR quantile predictability test Lee (2016, Proposition 3.2) via  (Suggests); returns estimated QR endogeneity rho_tau paper’s tuning rule. New ivx_qr_boot(): moving block bootstrap percentile intervals p-values IVX-QR (Fan & Lee, 2019), robust conditional heteroskedasticity sparsity estimate. New ivx_episodic(): subsample (rolling, forward backward recursive) IVX tests pockets predictability sup/inf functionals wild bootstrap p-values (Demetrescu et al. 2022, 2023 Section 3.2). Documented long-horizon statistic (horizon > 1) modified IVX-Wald Kostakis, Magdalinos & Stamatogiannis (2023), eqs (15)/(23), auditing implementation paper. New ivx_sys() / ivx_sys_fit(): systems predictive regressions matrix response (cbind(y1, y2) ~ x), short long horizon, Kronecker-form IVX-Wald covariance Kostakis et al. (2023); reports joint, per-equation individual Wald statistics. New vignettes methodology (ivx, ivx-sys, ivx-ar, ivx-ra, ivx-qr, robust-inference, ivx-episodic) underlying statistics, replication results caveats; pkgdown site reorganised (Bootstrap 5, MathJax rendering, grouped reference articles). New ivx_iv() / ivx_iv_fit(): 2SLS predictability tests Breitung & Demetrescu (2015) fractional-difference, long-difference sine instruments recommended combination (IVcomb), Eicker-White standard errors. New arm() / arm_fit(): multipredictor augmented regression method Amihud, Hurvich & Wang (2009) - reduced-bias OLS Nicholls-Pope corrected VAR(1) residuals control variables paper’s covariance estimator; non-IVX benchmark stationary persistent predictors. standard quasi-GLS-demeaned t-ratio paper’s conservative critical values strong persistence, normal critical values weak persistence (ADF/MBIC switch). New el_test(): unified empirical likelihood test Liu, Yang, Cai & Peng (2019) predictive regression augmented lagged difference predictor; chi-square profile EL ratios whatever persistence predictor, tuning parameters. New cy_test(): Bonferroni Q-test Campbell & Yogo (2006) (feasible Cavanagh, Elliott & Stock 1995 approach): DF-GLS confidence interval largest root inverted simulated local--unity quantiles, Table 2 levels, Q-estimates AR(p) correction Appendix . user-supplied orthogonalising covariates lags, Wald test Eicker-White standard errors remaining innovation correlation diagnostic. Fixed: weighted fits ignored horizon argument. extract() (texreg) now reports IVX standard errors instead Wald statistics se slot. ivx_ar() ivx_ar_fit() accept beta, cz, bandwidth robust arguments ivx().
